Make your festival decoration stand out with the pre-lit Christmas tree.
The pre-lit Xmas tree features 190/270 warm white(LED 1) and multi-color(LED 2) changeable LED lights, creating a refined festive ambiance. Offering 9 lighting modes（combination, LED1 steady on, LED2 steady on, LED1 slo-glo, LED1 slo-glo, LED1 & LED2 sequential, LED1 & LED2 twinkle, LED1 & LED2 slow fade, slo-glo）, 4 brightness levels, remote, and a 6 H timer, it effortlessly transitions from lively celebrations to cozy evenings. Designed with 509/713 dense branch tips, this realistic spruce tree presents a full and lush look. The combination of verdant leaves, snowy leaves and multi-color twisted laser leaves create a stunningly attractive and full appearance. Crafted from flame-retardant, smell-less PE and PVC, the full Xmas tree ensures safe and lasting use throughout the holiday season. The tree's 2/3-section design, foldable stand with a pre-installed bolt, hinged branches, and included pairs of gloves make assembly and storage both easy and convenient. 
Note: Ornaments are not included.

5037204465682.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Shatter Resistant Design
The ornaments use a shatter resistant construction for the stated decorative use. They provide an alternative to traditional glass decorations when arranging the display, while retaining a defined shape and finish for the festive setting.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Quantity: 48 pack.
Shatter resistant plastic construction provides a safe alternative to traditional glass ornaments for festive decorating.
Includes hanging cords on each bauble for easy and secure attachment to Christmas tree branches or displays.
Comes in a convenient 48 pack, offering ample quantity to fully decorate your Christmas tree with colour and detail.
Durable plastic material retains its defined shape and finish, ensuring long-lasting use for seasonal celebrations.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: Hanging Cord
Hanger included

5059574937682.sourceDescription:
Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Handmade Detail
Handmade detailing contributes to the character of the design. The decorative elements give the product a distinct appearance that can be coordinated with the surrounding arrangement.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Polyester. Product measurements: height 20 cm. Quantity: 1 set.
Handmade detailing adds character and a distinct appearance to your festive display.
Features a recognisable Father Christmas motif for seasonal charm.
Made from durable polyester, designed to maintain its shape and detail over time.
Easy to store and handle gently when not in use to preserve quality.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 1 set

5096042277482.baseName: LED Christmas wreath - Light-up door wreath - 40 LEDs and silver door hanger for a hallway or mantel - Green and white, 60 cm
5096042277482.variantName: LED Christmas wreath - Light-up door wreath - 40 LEDs and silver door hanger for a hallway or mantel - Green and white, 60 cm
5096042277482.sourceDescription:
Snowy branches and a silver-coloured hanger lend this 60 cm wreath a cool finish. The 40 LEDs sit amongst the foliage and are timer controlled, while the 29.5 cm hanger provides a matching way to position it.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. Consider the drop of the hanger as well as the size of the wreath when choosing a door. Hold the two together before positioning them, so the arrangement sits comfortably between the upper panel and the handle.

The pale tips give the arrangement its own highlights in daylight. Against dark paint the snowy edge is easy to follow, while a lighter background draws attention to the darker details tucked further into the design. A green wreath also works as a bridge between rooms. Choose one shade from your tree decorations for the hallway and repeat it in a small accent beside the wreath, letting the greenery carry the rest of the scheme.

Choose the start of the lighting period with the room's usual evening routine in mind. It is worth checking the controls while the wreath is still within reach, before moving it to its final position. The centre opening lets the background play a part in the design.

For a wall arrangement, try the wreath above a narrow console with the centre of the design just below eye level. A clear strip of wall between the wreath and the furniture shows off the outline and leaves the surface free for keys or Christmas cards. Think about access to the controls before choosing the final position. Leave enough room to reach the switch comfortably while keeping the front of the arrangement clear, especially if you plan to change the lighting during the evening.
Features 40 LEDs with a built-in timer for convenient automated lighting control.
Includes a 29.5 cm silver door hanger for easy and secure positioning on doors or mantels.
Designed with snow-effect branches in green and white to create a festive winter atmosphere.
Compact 60 cm diameter size is ideal for hallways, doors, or wall displays without overwhelming the space.
Comes with Silver door hanger
Hanging rope included

5096042276782.baseName: Christmas wreath - Festive door decoration - Unlit snowy pine and red berries for doors and walls - Green, white and red, 30 cm
5096042276782.variantName: Christmas wreath - Festive door decoration - Unlit snowy pine and red berries for doors and walls - Green, white and red, 30 cm
5096042276782.sourceDescription:
A dusting of white on artificial pine needles makes the bright berries and natural pine cones stand out. The 30 cm wreath is about 10 cm deep and comes with a hanging point. Its unlit finish needs no power supply.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. Small red berries show especially clearly against a simple backdrop. If you want to tie the wreath into a larger Christmas scheme, repeat their red in a nearby ornament and let the foliage provide the quieter colour.

The pale tips give the arrangement its own highlights in daylight. Against dark paint the snowy edge is easy to follow, while a lighter background draws attention to the darker details tucked further into the design. For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere. A ribbon tied off-centre can pick up a colour from the tree without covering the sprigs.

When you unpack the greenery, support the wreath from behind and ease any compressed outer sprigs apart gently. Turn the wreath as you work so that you can check the outline from the front as well as from the side. From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents.

Hung on a panelled door, a wreath looks best when the edges of the panel still show. Centre it on the panel itself and look at it from the far end of the hall before choosing the final hanging height. To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together.
Festive snowy pine design with bright red berries and natural pine cones for a classic Christmas look.
Compact 30 cm diameter size ideal for doors, walls or small spaces without overwhelming the area.
Unlit finish requires no power supply, making it safe and easy to hang anywhere indoors or out.
Includes a convenient hanging point for immediate display on doors, walls or mantelpieces.
Comes with Hanging attachment
Hanging rope included

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

A flexible finishing touch

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. Dimensions: 30 cm. Quantity: 1 set.

Compact 30 cm size allows for versatile placement as a focal point or accent piece.
Versatile decoration suitable for coordinating with existing room colour and texture schemes.
Simple design enables easy adjustment of spacing and positioning within any arrangement.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

5037204473182.sourceDescription:
Inflatable Santa
This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The multicoloured finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.
